soqucoin.upside: Post-quantum chain with a testnet bridge demo; mainnet was targeted Q3 2026 and I found no confirmation it launched.
soqucoin.cheap: New, thinly covered project; nearly all sources are the project's own pages.
soqucoin.wrongIf: Mainnet does not launch by 2026-12 or the team stops posting code.
soqucoin.vsScanner: Scanner shows alive; I could verify only the project's own claims.

concordium.upside: A named enterprise/AI push (Danish hockey federation partnership, May 2026) could bring some on-chain usage; no dated catalyst found.
concordium.cheap: Small AI/privacy L1 with uncapped 4% yearly minting dilutes holders; market sees no demand story.
concordium.wrongIf: Daily trading falls back under normal levels without any announcement, or no new partner is announced by 2027-01.
concordium.vsScanner: Scanner counts the 8x volume spike as a plus; I found no news behind it.

kyo.upside: Soneium DEX with Series A funding (Nov 2025) and a 163x one-day volume spike, but I found no news explaining it.
kyo.cheap: Market cap only a few million dollars; a one-day spike on tiny base volume is a weak signal.
kyo.wrongIf: Daily trading goes back to ~normal within days and no listing or launch is announced.
kyo.vsScanner: Scanner spike is likely noise; lesson from 10-22: volume alone is not a catalyst.

ergo.upside: Long-running proof-of-work privacy/smart-contract chain with an alive team; no dated catalyst found.
ergo.cheap: Old-cycle L1 with little new attention; 100x below ATH is not a reason by itself.
ergo.wrongIf: The 4.8x volume spike fades within a week with no news.
ergo.vsScanner: Agree with the scanner that it is alive, but nothing explains the spike.

stargate-finance.upside: STG holders can swap into ZRO at a fixed rate after the LayerZero deal, so price may track ZRO; reports I found on a June 2026 bid were not corroborated.
stargate-finance.cheap: Token is tied to a conversion rate, so it trades like a thin ZRO proxy rather than on its own story.
stargate-finance.wrongIf: STG trades materially away from 0.08634 ZRO or the swap terms change.
stargate-finance.vsScanner: Scanner sees a spike; I see a mechanical price anchor, not a mispricing.

nano.upside: Mature payments coin with a steady community; no dated catalyst found.
nano.cheap: Old fee-less payment coin that lost attention; no sign of a fresh reason to re-rate.
nano.wrongIf: Still no new exchange or merchant integration by 2027-01.
nano.vsScanner: Agree with the scanner; no spike or news to add.
